# Genuine HEIC fixtures

- `0003.heic`: portrait HEIC from libheif-js's upstream test-image collection,
  https://github.com/catdad-experiments/libheif-js/blob/master/scripts/images.js
  (1125 × 2436). Used to verify tall portraits and misleading MIME types.
- `iphone_13_pro_max.HEIC`: genuine 12 MP iPhone camera sample, 3024 × 4032,
  https://github.com/ianare/exif-samples/blob/master/heic/mobile/iphone_13_pro_max.HEIC
  User-contributed samples are Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International per
  https://github.com/ianare/exif-samples/blob/master/README.rst.
  License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/.

Fixtures are unmodified and are used only with an isolated browser backend and
temporary Google Docs. They must never be uploaded as entries in the live journal.
libheif-js is LGPL-3.0; its unmodified decoder and corresponding source are
available at https://github.com/catdad-experiments/libheif-js and
https://github.com/strukturag/libheif. The application source is in this repository.
